programme.title: Sanctuary: Ritorno Dall'Aldila
programme.desc: Will soffre di amnesia riguardo agli eventi della sua esperienza di pre-morte, ma alcuni visitatori indesiderati diventano intenzionati a scoprire cosa è bloccato nella sua memoria.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Rapina In Banca
programme.desc: La squadra va in missione di routine per recuperare un Anormale e portarlo al sicuro. Ma la missione diventa tutt'altro che di routine quando sono costretti a mettere in scena una rapina in banca per proteggere il pubblico dai danni.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Scia Di Sangue
programme.desc: La squadra riceve una criptica chiamata di soccorso che potrebbe provenire solo da una persona... Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Supereroe 2: La Freccia Spezzata
programme.desc: Kate acquisisce abilità da supereroe quando un Anormale si attacca a lei per proteggerla.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Animus
programme.desc: Will e Henry vanno nel Regno Unito per seguire l'avvistamento di un lupo mannaro e finiscono per scoprire un oscuro collegamento con il passato... e il futuro di Henry.

programme.title: Sanctuary: La Violazione
programme.desc: Magnus risponde a una chiamata anonima di aiuto in un edificio abbandonato. Ma quando rimane intrappolata all'interno, scopre che chiunque abbia fatto la chiamata ha un'agenda molto diversa.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Per Il Re e Per La Patria
programme.desc: Con Adam Worth sotto stretta sorveglianza al Santuario, Magnus rivela i turbolenti inizi che condivide con i Cinque.
programme.sub-title: Per Il Re e Per La Patria

programme.title: Sanctuary: La Veglia
programme.desc: Ignorando l'avvertimento di Magnus, Will accetta l'offerta di Adam Worth di mostrare loro come accedere alla Città nascosta.

programme.title: Sanctuary: La Citta Sotterranea
programme.desc: Magnus e la squadra si preparano per il viaggio, sperando di trovare l'ingresso alla città nascosta... e il padre di Magnus.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Pax Romana
programme.desc: Dopo aver ottenuto con successo l'accesso alla città di Praxis nella Terra Cava, Magnus e la squadra sono accolti con ostilità dal leader della città Ranna che ha un'agenda segreta.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Difficile Risveglio
programme.desc: Magnus torna a casa da un viaggio notturno per trovare il Santuario in uno stato di caos sconcertante:detriti di battaglia ovunque,nessuno in vista,e un'ispezione programmata della squadra di sicurezza delle Nazioni Unite a poche ore di distanza.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Una Notte
programme.desc: Quello che è iniziato come un innocente primo appuntamento per Will e Abby, si trasforma in un pericoloso rapimento da parte di una banda il cui leader affronta morte certa senza il loro aiuto.

programme.title: Sanctuary: L'Uomo Falena
programme.desc: Will è insolitamente assente alla riunione mattutina della squadra. E il motivo della sua assenza lo fa letteralmente arrampicare sui muri.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Wingman
programme.desc: Il doppio appuntamento di Will e Henry va storto quando Magnus insiste che facciano una consegna diretta di un Anormale mentre vanno alla loro prenotazione per la cena.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Il Risveglio
programme.desc: Magnus e Tesla indagano su un'ex roccaforte praxiana e si rendono conto che potrebbero aver involontariamente scoperto i segreti della razza Vampiris.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Normandia
programme.desc: In uno sguardo indietro alla Seconda Guerra Mondiale, troviamo Magnus, Watson e Griffin alla vigilia del D-Day... e scopriamo il ruolo di Magnus in uno degli eventi più importanti che hanno dato forma al nostro mondo.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Carentan
programme.desc: Il Santuario riceve segnalazioni di inspiegabili sparizioni a Carentan, nella regione francese della Normandia, e parte per indagare sugli strani avvenimenti.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Fuori Dalla Realta
programme.desc: Nessun Santuario in vista, Helen e Will si ritrovano come vicini di casa in una strada alberata di periferia... vivendo vite che nessuno dei due riconosce pienamente.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Avvolti Nell'Ombra
programme.desc: Il Santuario riceve la notizia allarmante che un grande gruppo di anormali è stato avvistato all'ingresso di una grotta nel Sud Dakota. Magnus sa immediatamente che questa è la prima ondata di Anormali che emerge dalla Terra Cava.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Viaggio Nel Tempo
programme.desc: Adam Worth distrugge Praxis e viaggia indietro nel tempo fino al 1890 per salvare sua figlia. La dottoressa Magnus viaggia indietro nel tempo per fermarlo prima che danneggi la linea del tempo e distrugga con essa il suo futuro.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Ghosts of Bolton Sea Cadets
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team heads to Bolton to check out the alleged haunting at Sea Cadets academy.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 1
programme.desc: Many urban explorers have encountered paranormal activity inside of the building, including child like figures, unexplained voices and strange knocking sounds. Will anything from the ghost dimension make contact?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 2
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate Norris Green Mansion. A 17th Century building, which is believed to hold some of the most haunted spirits in Liverpool. Will they make contact its ghostly entities tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 1
programme.desc: Bex and Sean are joined by a special guest as they investigate an abandoned home full of spirits in Liverpool.
programme.sub-title: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 2
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension encounter something paranormal in this exclusive unseen footage from their invetsigation of the Soul Less House in Liverpool.
programme.sub-title: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex begin their chilling investigation at the historic Clifton Hall Masonic Temple. Hidden behind closed doors for over a century, this sacred space holds more than just ritual secrets. They explore the eerie corridors and lodge rooms.
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Masonic Temple – Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The investigation continues as Bex and Sean split up to face the darkness alone inside Clifton Hall. From intelligent knocking and voices to the chilling sound of a child and unseen footsteps on the carpet.
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Masonic Temple – Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In a church reborn as a gym, something old still lingers in the shadows. Sean and Bex investigate Dream Body Gym inside the former Manor Church — where whispers echo through stairwells, music box melodies drift through empty rooms.
programme.sub-title: Haunted Strength – The Church Gym Investigation

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Deep in the woods on the outskirts of Liverpool lie the crumbling remains of a forgotten gatehouse — and the land surrounding it is said to be cursed. As Sean and Bex begin their nighttime investigation, unsettling activity begins to unfold.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex head to one of Leeds’ oldest public libraries, where the silence hides more than just books. Reports of shadow figures, unexplained voices, and a terrifying presence in the basement have kept rumours alive for decades.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In the first of a five-part investigation inside the historic Greenfield Valley Heritage Park, the team explores the eerie ruins of the old mills. Known for reports of ghostly children, unexplained footsteps, and phantom knocks on stone walls.
programme.sub-title: Greenfield Valley: Echoes of the Mill : Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: As the team delves deeper into the Valley Mills, subtle sounds begin to stir the silence—unheard by the cameras, but felt by those present. A chilling metallic swing echoes through the empty building with no visible source.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In this chilling third part of our Greenfield Valley investigation, we continue deep within the historic mills—where echoes of the past seem to come alive. With intense K2 meter spikes, disembodied footsteps and unexplained sounds.
programme.sub-title: Whispers of the Forgotten – Greenfield Valley: Part 3

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In the historic heart of Greenfield Valley Mills, Sean and Bex uncover chilling echoes of its industrial past. Once alive with the hum of machinery and the toil of mill workers, the site now stands in eerie silence.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: In this chilling investigation, the Ghost Dimension team travel deep into Greenfield Valley to uncover the haunted secrets of Basingwerk Abbey. Once home to Cistercian monks and steeped in centuries of devotion and conflict.
programme.sub-title: Echoes of the Abbey: Hauntings at Greenfield Valley: Part 5

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: The Lady in Grey
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate claims of a ghost lady in grey haunting Windleshaw abbey, St Helens, Merseyside. Over 600 years old and with new paranormal encounters reported almost weekly. Bex and Sean attempt to make contact with the infamous lady in grey.

programme.title: Ghost Dimensions Top 10 Scariest Moments
programme.desc: A special look into the top 10 of Ghost Dimension’s scariest moments. Venturing into the UK’s most haunted buildings, we take a look back at the scariest captures.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Scars for Life
programme.desc: Could a tattoo studio be haunted? Has a Ouija board opened a gateway to the spirit dimension? Ghost Dimension spend the night investigating Deviant Ink tattoo studio.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Fort Crosby
programme.desc: Crosby Battery, also known as Crosby Point Battery and Fort Crosby, was an artillery battery situated between Crosby and Hightown in Lancashire, United Kingdom. The battery was used for port defence and anti-aircraft defence during WWII.

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.sub-title: No puedes irte a casa de nuevo

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.desc: While on a road trip through a desert, mild-mannered high-school teacher Ralph Hinkley (temporarily changed to Ralph Hanley for part of season one due to real-life current events) is greeted by extraterrestrials, who present him with an extraordinary red flying suit that imbues him with uncanny powers. programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.title: Stalag 17
programme.desc: In a Nazi prison barracks, other POWs believe that a cynical American sergeant (William Holden) is an informer.

programme.title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
programme.desc: A drifter (John Garfield) stops at a Greek diner and helps the owner's (Cecil Kellaway) lusty wife (Lana Turner) become a widow.

programme.title: His Kind of Woman
programme.desc: Lured to Mexico, a gambler (Robert Mitchum) meets a café singer (Jane Russell) and learns a gangster wants his face.

programme.title: Gun Crazy
programme.desc: A gun fanatic (John Dall) and a sideshow sharpshooter (Peggy Cummins) team up for romance and a crime spree.

programme.title: Brubaker
programme.desc: The new warden (Robert Redford) of a corrupt Southern prison starts by posing as an inmate to observe its brutality.

programme.title: The Comancheros
programme.desc: A Texas Ranger (John Wayne) and a fugitive gambler (Stuart Whitman) stop white renegades running guns and liquor.

programme.title: Blood on the Moon
programme.desc: A Texas gunfighter (Robert Mitchum) helps an old friend (Robert Preston) stir up a feud between ranchers and settlers.

programme.title: Tom Horn
programme.desc: Turn-of-the-century Wyoming ranchers hire the legendary bounty hunter (Steve McQueen) to stop cattle rustlers.

programme.title: Alvarez Kelly
programme.desc: A Confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) makes a cattleman (William Holden) teach his troops how to herd Union cattle.

programme.title: Rio Bravo
programme.desc: A small-town sheriff in the American West enlists the help of an old man, a drunk, and a young gunfighter in his efforts to hold in jail the brother of the local bad guy.

programme.title: River of No Return
programme.desc: A farmer (Robert Mitchum) and his son raft Rockies rapids with a gold-rush gambler's (Rory Calhoun) girlfriend (Marilyn Monroe).

programme.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
programme.desc: A disabled serviceman and two other veterans (Fredric March, Dana Andrews) have difficulty adjusting to civilian life after World War II.

programme.title: Breaking Away
programme.desc: An Indiana teen (Dennis Christopher) acts Italian as he and his townie buddies (Dennis Quaid, Daniel Stern) compete with college snobs.

programme.title: The Driver
programme.desc: An obsessed police detective (Bruce Dern) chases a professional driver (Ryan O'Neal) of getaway cars.

programme.title: To the Shores of Tripoli
programme.desc: An arrogant playboy (John Payne) joins the Marines, woos a nurse (Maureen O'Hara), clashes with his sergeant (Randolph Scott) and shapes up.

programme.title: What Price Glory?
programme.desc: Capt. Flagg (James Cagney) rivals Sgt. Quirt (Dan Dailey) for an innkeeper's daughter (Corinne Calvet) in World War I France.

programme.title: The Caine Mutiny
programme.desc: A World War II Naval officer is court-martialed for relieving paranoid Capt. Queeg of command during a typhoon.

programme.title: PT 109
programme.desc: Navy Lt. John F. Kennedy (Cliff Robertson) and crew are marooned after their boat is cut in two by a Japanese destroyer.

programme.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
programme.desc: A British POW colonel (Alec Guinness) orders his men to build their Japanese captor (Sessue Hayakawa) a railway bridge in the jungle.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: An Army sergeant (Humphrey Bogart), his tank crew (Bruce Bennett, Dan Duryea) and stragglers hold off a Nazi battalion at a waterhole.

programme.title: Auntie Mame
programme.desc: A Bohemian socialite (Rosalind Russell) survives the market crash of 1929, marries a millionaire (Forrest Tucker) and teaches her nephew how to live.

programme.title: Monkey Business
programme.desc: Drinking an elixir makes a professor (Cary Grant) and his wife (Ginger Rogers) act teenage and worse.

programme.title: I Was a Male War Bride

programme.sub-title: Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
programme.desc: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
programme.desc: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
programme.desc: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
programme.desc: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
programme.desc: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
programme.desc: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
programme.desc: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
programme.desc: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.
